title: Counter and Shapes
prompt: Implement class `Counter` with: a constructor taking an initial value (default 0), `inc()` (+1), `reset()` (back to the value it was constructed with), and `value() const`. The count must never go below the initial value (inc past it is fine). Then implement `total_area(const std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Shape>>&)` given the Shape/Circle/Square definitions in the boilerplate.

tests.name: reset
tests.hint: Reset returns to the CONSTRUCTED value, not zero.

tests.name: const-safe
tests.hint: value() must be const-callable on const references.

tests.name: area polymorphic
tests.hint: 4 + π, chosen at runtime through the base interface.
